What happens when you put a video model in control of a robot?

In episode three of Inside View, Rik Heijdens from our robotics team explains how Praxis-1 uses what a robot sees to guide its next move.

Subscribe on YouTube for new episodes every week: https://lnkd.in/ehzYSNH5
